title: C_Verify: missing memset before wc_HmacInit
description: C_Sign correctly zeroes the Hmac struct (wolfP11-z3c7 pattern) before wc_HmacInit to prevent wc_HmacFree from dereferencing garbage pointers. C_Verify has the identical wc_HmacInit call but omits the memset. Any HMAC-verify call can crash via garbage-pointer dereference inside wc_HmacFree.
